subject: Hosted API evaluation — demo scheduling
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API evaluation - interested in a quick demo

Hi Marissa,

We signed up for the Hosted API self-serve trial and I'm evaluating whether Redwood's Hosted API can meet our latency/cost needs. Could we schedule a 30-minute demo next week to walk through:
- model catalog and performance profiles
- pricing/quotas and cost controls
- observability and rollout options

I'm on Pacific time and available mornings Oct 7-9. Happy to loop in our procurement lead if needed.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Product Manager, Acme Corp
sarah.lin@acme-corp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation - interested in a quick demo

Hi Sarah — thanks for signing up and for the note. I'd love to run a focused 30-minute walkthrough tailored to your evaluation. Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 7, 9:00–9:30 AM
- Wed Oct 8, 10:00–10:30 AM
- Thu Oct 9, 9:00–9:30 AM

If you share which slot works best I will send a calendar invite. Draft agenda I suggest:
1) Quick intros + goals (5m)
2) Hosted API demo: model catalog, perf profiles, streaming (10m)
3) Observability, rollout & cost controls (10m)
4) Next steps & procurement touchpoints (5m)

Also attaching a short eval questionnaire helps us prepare — would you prefer I send our questionnaire or will you share yours? I'm looping in Ethan (sales manager) in case procurement or pricing questions come up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/30min]
